blocks.x: Each Driisti Smart Vision Glasses deployment starts with one decision class in production — not a program of twenty. The evidence pack grows with the rollout, so by the time the third use case goes live, the audit story is already routine.

Operators see Driisti Smart Vision Glasses as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: a working session on Driisti Smart Vision Glasses baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
